verdict.rationale: An official template exists at anthropics/skills/template/SKILL.md with `name: template-skill` and a placeholder `description`. The Agent Skills spec documents the required frontmatter (example `name`/`description` block, description length and content rules, YAML-then-Markdown format) and the directory layout. There is also a first-party skill-creator skill for scaffolding new skills, and community users report building and adapting their own skills from the repo. Missing for 10: the `name` field's constraints are not evidenced, and no independent walkthrough confirms authoring from the template alone without consulting existing skills.
